guide_solution: (a) A cobbler was happy to lead a simple life. (b) He had a neighbour who was very rich. (c) The nighbour wanted to help him by giving him some money. (d) Getting the huge amount of money, the cobbler lost happiness. (e) But if he had not taken the money from his neighbour, he would have led a happy life.
